subject: reasoning
question:
Instructions: Carefully examine the Reference Statement. Then, identify the single option among the four alternatives (a, b, c, d) that is an EXACT AND COMPLETE REPLICATION of the Reference Statement. Pay exceptionally close attention to every character, number, symbol, space, and punctuation mark.

Reference: Geneva, Switzerland: October 24th, 1945 (UN Day).
solution:
The reference statement given in the problem is,

Geneva, Switzerland: October 24th, 1945 (UN Day).

Let's match this statement with the given options one by one to figure out which one is exactly the same.

 
 

 **Option**
 **Statement in Option**
 **Given Statement**
 **Comment**
 
 

 (1)
 Geneva, Switzerland: October 24th, 1945 (UN Day).
 Geneva, Switzerland: October 24th, 1945 (UN Day).
 The statement is exactly the same as the given reference.
 
 

 (2)
 Geneva, Switzerland: October 24th, 1945 (U.N. Day).
 Geneva, Switzerland: October 24th, 1945 (UN Day).
 This option has “U.N. Day” instead of “UN Day”.
 
 

 (3)
 Geneva, Switzerlan.d: October 24th, 1945 (UN Day).
 Geneva, Switzerland: October 24th, 1945 (UN Day).
 This option has “Switzerlan.d” instead of “Switzerland”.
 
 

 (4)
 Geneva, Switzerland: Octobr 24th, 1945 (UN Day).
 Geneva, Switzerland: October 24th, 1945 (UN Day).
 This option has “Octobr” instead of “October”.
 
 

So, the statement that is exactly the same as the given reference statement is in option (1).

Hence, the correct option is "**option (1)**".
